bends.reason: B1, end flange on one short end of the low (joggled) strip. Raw TOP: the strip end is a thin edge-on line flush with the main panel's B2 end, with no flat ~33 px extension (raw TOP mirrored-fit to CAD TOP: IoU 0.997, zero residual). Raw SIDE: an edge-on flange at the B1/B2 end projects past the low-strip band. Registered overlay (confidence OK): CAD fully covered, no extra scan. Same sense as the other edge flanges (opposite side to the tabs), matching the CAD.

B2, main-panel end flange on the bottom-tab side. Raw TOP: dark edge-on line along that panel end, corner ear beyond the B12 line as in the CAD, and a panel y-extent equal to the formed CAD's (no flat strip, zero fit residual). Raw FRONT: the main-panel band is the B2/B10 flanges seen face-on, on the side opposite the tabs, as in the CAD. Raw SIDE: edge-on flange at that end. Overlay: full coverage. Sense matches the CAD.

B3, outer long-edge flange of the low strip. Raw TOP: the strip's outer edge is a thin dark edge-on line, and the strip width matches the formed CAD (~90 vs 93 px; a flat flange would make it ~126 px). Raw FRONT: dark end cap at the outer end of the low strip (flange edge-on, slightly smeared by the raw frame's ~2.4 deg rotation). Overlay: full coverage. Same sense as the other edge flanges.

B4, lower bend of the Z-joggle (riser to low strip). Raw FRONT clearly shows the vertical riser with rounded ~90 deg corners at both ends, and the low strip turned back parallel to the main panel, offset by the riser height. Raw TOP shows the riser as a dark band between the panel and the strip. Reverse sense to B11 (the Z pair), exactly as in the CAD.

B5, small end ear of the bottom-slot lanced tab (bend line normal to the panel at the tab's slanted end; per the CAD SIDE it continues on from B6, elevated). Raw TOP at 9x: the tab's edge-on line stops short of the slanted slot tip and a short stub turns away from the slot (+y), matching the CAD's formed ear. An unbent ear would instead continue the tab line out to the tip. The bottom slot including its slanted end is open. Small feature but resolved in TOP; sense matches the CAD.

B6, base bend of the bottom-slot lanced tab. Raw TOP/ISO: the bottom slot is open (tab material lifted out of the panel), with a dark edge-on tab line along its outer edge. Raw FRONT: the tab block stands off the panel on the side opposite the edge flanges (reverse sense vs the flanges, as in the CAD). Raw SIDE: tab stub beyond the panel band, with the opening visible through it. Overlay: the tab stub and block are covered by scan.

B7, small end ear of the top-slot lanced tab (bend line normal to the panel at the tab's slanted end; per the CAD SIDE it continues on from B8, elevated). Raw TOP at 9x: the tab's edge-on line ends before the slanted slot tip and a short ~12 px stub turns away from the slot (-y), matching the CAD's formed ear at B7. An unbent ear would continue the tab line to the tip. Registered FRONT: the tab block's top edge ends where the CAD's does, with no ear protrusion. Sense matches the CAD.

B8, base bend of the top-slot lanced tab. Raw TOP/ISO: the top slot is open, with a dark edge-on tab line along its outer edge. Raw FRONT: the tab block is on the side opposite the flanges (reverse sense vs the flanges, as in the CAD). Raw SIDE: tab stub plus opening. Registered overlay FRONT: the scan's tab block matches the CAD's raised-block silhouette exactly.

B9, end flange on the other short end of the low strip. Raw TOP: the strip end is flush with the main panel's B10 end as a thin edge-on line, with no flat extension (TOP fit zero residual). Raw SIDE: edge-on flange at the B9/B10 end, extending past the low-strip band. Overlay: full coverage. Same sense as the other edge flanges.

B10, main-panel end flange on the top-tab side. Raw TOP: dark edge-on line along that panel end, plus the corner ear beyond the B12 line. Raw SIDE: prominent edge-on flange spanning the panel band at that end. Raw FRONT: the band is the flanges face-on, opposite the tabs, as in the CAD. No flat strip (TOP fit zero residual); overlay full coverage.

B11, upper bend of the Z-joggle (main panel to riser). Raw FRONT: the riser drops ~90 deg from the main panel at a rounded corner, and the low strip is offset accordingly. Raw TOP: dark riser band at the panel/strip junction. Sense matches the CAD (toward the flange side; B4 is its reverse partner).

B12, outer long-edge flange of the main panel. Raw FRONT: vertical end cap at the far end of the panel band, with the corner ears beyond it. Overlay: full coverage. Same sense as the other edge flanges.
